hawassa.city_overview: Capital of the Sidama Region and a popular weekend escape from Addis Ababa. A vibrant lakeside city at 1,685m in the Great Rift Valley, known for warm hospitality, fresh fish, and birdlife.
hawassa.resort_location: On the shores of Lake Hawassa with direct lake access, beach bar, and panoramic views from rooms and restaurants.

nearby_attractions.name: Lake Hawassa
nearby_attractions.description: Freshwater Rift Valley lake with hippos, pelicans, and fish eagles. Boat tours available.

nearby_attractions.name: Amora Gedel Fish Market (Asa Gebeya)
nearby_attractions.description: Iconic lakeside fish market where fishermen sell fresh tilapia. Best visited at sunrise.

nearby_attractions.name: Mount Tabor
nearby_attractions.description: Short hike to panoramic views over the city and lake. Popular at sunset.

nearby_attractions.name: Saint Gabriel Church
nearby_attractions.description: Important Orthodox church, especially active during annual festivals.

nearby_attractions.name: Wondo Genet Hot Springs
nearby_attractions.description: Natural hot springs in a forest setting. Popular day trip for swimming and relaxation.

nearby_attractions.name: Abidjatta-Shalla National Park
nearby_attractions.description: Flamingos, ostriches, and diverse birdlife around two Rift Valley lakes.

transport.airport: Hawassa International Airport, ~10 km from city center
transport.bus_station: Selam Bus and other services to Addis Ababa (5–6 hours)

arba minch.city_overview: Gateway city to southern Ethiopia's tribal regions and national parks. Named 'forty springs,' it sits between two of Ethiopia's largest Rift Valley lakes — Abaya and Chamo.
arba minch.resort_location: Grand viewpoint overlooking twin lakes Abaya and Chamo with evergreen vegetation and mountain backdrop.

nearby_attractions.name: Lake Chamo
nearby_attractions.description: Boat tours to see Nile crocodiles, hippos, and pelicans. Famous 'crocodile market.'

nearby_attractions.name: Lake Abaya
nearby_attractions.description: Larger of the twin lakes with dramatic red waters and mountain views.

nearby_attractions.name: Nechisar National Park
nearby_attractions.description: Zebras, gazelles, hippos, and the 'Bridge of God' isthmus between the two lakes.

nearby_attractions.name: Dorze Village
nearby_attractions.description: Highland village famous for bamboo beehive-shaped houses and weaving traditions.

nearby_attractions.name: Forty Springs (Arba Minch)
nearby_attractions.description: Natural springs that give the city its name. Peaceful forest setting.

nearby_attractions.name: Omo Valley
nearby_attractions.description: Multi-day trips to visit diverse tribal communities. Book through hotel concierge.

transport.airport: Arba Minch Airport with free hotel shuttle
transport.local: Hotel-arranged tours recommended for national park and village visits

ziway.city_overview: Small lakeside town on Lake Ziway, one of the Rift Valley's freshwater lakes. A peaceful stopover known for birdlife and island monasteries.
ziway.resort_location: Lakefront property with pool, tennis, and garden terrace.

nearby_attractions.name: Lake Ziway
nearby_attractions.description: Boat trips to see pelicans, fish eagles, and island monasteries.

nearby_attractions.name: Tulu Gudo Island
nearby_attractions.description: Island monastery said to have housed the Ark of the Covenant in medieval times.

nearby_attractions.name: Ziway Vineyards
nearby_attractions.description: Local wine production in the Rift Valley.

transport.local: Walking along lakeside; bajaj for town

adama.city_overview: Second-largest city in Oromia Region and a major Rift Valley hub, 100 km southeast of Addis Ababa. Known for warm climate and access to Awash National Park.
adama.resort_location: City resort with conference facilities, restaurant, and parking.

nearby_attractions.name: Awash National Park
nearby_attractions.description: Oryx, baboons, crocodiles, and hot springs. One of Ethiopia's oldest national parks.

nearby_attractions.name: Sodere Hot Springs
nearby_attractions.description: Resort area with natural hot springs and swimming pools.

nearby_attractions.name: Adama Markets
nearby_attractions.description: Local markets with fresh produce, spices, and textiles.

addis_ababa.city_overview: Ethiopia's capital and Africa's diplomatic hub at 2,355m. A vibrant mix of ancient culture, museums, markets, and modern development.
addis_ababa.resort_location: Lamberet Square, Asmara Road, Yeka sub-city. 4.3 mi from Bole International Airport.

nearby_attractions.name: National Museum of Ethiopia
nearby_attractions.description: Home of 'Lucy' (Dinkinesh) and extensive Ethiopian art and archaeology.

nearby_attractions.name: Holy Trinity Cathedral
nearby_attractions.description: Neo-baroque cathedral and burial site of Emperor Haile Selassie.

nearby_attractions.name: Entoto Hill & Park
nearby_attractions.description: Eucalyptus forest, Maryam Church, and panoramic views over the city.

nearby_attractions.name: Merkato
nearby_attractions.description: One of Africa's largest open-air markets. Best with a guide.

nearby_attractions.name: Addis Ababa Museum
nearby_attractions.description: City history from founding to present.

nearby_attractions.name: Matti Multiplex Theater
nearby_attractions.description: Modern cinema and entertainment complex nearby.

nearby_attractions.name: Ethnological Museum (Addis Ababa University)
nearby_attractions.description: Housed in Haile Selassie's former palace. Excellent cultural overview.

transport.airport: Bole International Airport (ADD), free hotel shuttle
transport.local: Ride apps (Ride, Feres), blue taxis, Light Rail (selected routes)

gondar.city_overview: Historic imperial capital at 2,133m, known as the 'Camelot of Africa' for its royal castles. UNESCO World Heritage Site and gateway to the Simien Mountains.
gondar.resort_location: Within reach of Fasil Ghebbi and major historic sites. Pool, restaurant, and conference facilities.

nearby_attractions.name: Fasil Ghebbi (Royal Enclosure)
nearby_attractions.description: Six 17th-century castles including Fasilides' Castle. The heart of Gondar's imperial heritage.

nearby_attractions.name: Debre Berhan Selassie Church
nearby_attractions.description: Famous for its ceiling of 80 angel faces. One of Ethiopia's most beautiful churches.

nearby_attractions.name: Fasilides' Bath
nearby_attractions.description: Royal bathing pool used for Timkat (Epiphany) celebrations every January 19.

nearby_attractions.name: Simien Mountains National Park
nearby_attractions.description: Dramatic escarpments, gelada baboons, Walia ibex. Day trips or multi-day treks.

nearby_attractions.name: Kidame Gebeya Market
nearby_attractions.description: Traditional market for crafts, spices, and daily goods.

nearby_attractions.name: Kuskuam Complex
nearby_attractions.description: Ruins of Empress Mentewab's palace and church.

transport.airport: Gondar Airport (GDQ), 1-hour flight from Addis Ababa
transport.local: Bajaj and hotel-arranged guides for historic sites
